name: C & I Leasing PLC
source: C and I Leasing Plc unaudited consolidated income statement for the second quarter ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), group six months column, thousands scaled to naira. Revenue is the printed gross earnings. Lease expenses and finance cost are netted inside gross earnings in this lease format, so cost of sales, gross profit and net finance costs are not printed as standalone lines and are left blank. Operating expenses are impairment, depreciation, personnel and other operating expenses. EPS as printed in kobo converted to naira, confirmed against 2,948,577,000 shares. | AfricanFinancials (audited summary) | CRON 2026-10-13: FY2025 profit before tax and the income tax credit taken from the audited C & I Leasing Plc AFS for the year ended 31 December 2025 (directors' report summarised group results), read from the filed PDF.
